entities.name: TIARA
entities.description: A method that introduces constrained decoding to control the output space and reduce generation errors.

entities.name: MindMap
entities.description: A method that adjusts LLM prompts to achieve multi-step reasoning by generating both answers and the reasoning process.

entities.name: Constrained Decoding
entities.description: A technique used by TIARA to restrict generated tokens to options existing in tries containing KB classes and relations.

entities.name: Beam Search
entities.description: A generation strategy compared against constrained decoding in the context of TIARA.

entities.name: Query Decomposition into Instructions
entities.description: A technique where query representations are decomposed into multiple vectors termed 'instructions' used as conditions during message passing.

entities.name: Noun Extraction and Subgraph Insertion
entities.description: A technique where nouns from QA pairs are extracted and inserted as nodes into the retrieved subgraph.
